primary_goal: Direct visitors into gender-specific shopping categories (Women, Men, Kids) to personalize their browsing experience.

friction_points.issue: Absence of German market trust signals, shipping conditions, and payment logos visible above or below the fold.
friction_points.evidence: No mention of free shipping, 100-day returns, or trust badges (e.g., Trusted Shops, Klarna, PayPal logos) visible anywhere in the hero section or header.

friction_points.issue: Generic, low-contrast button styling for key entrance paths without visual previews.
friction_points.evidence: The entry points 'Women', 'Men', and 'Kids' are simple black pill buttons without visual category teasers or strong visual hierarchy.

friction_points.issue: SEO text wall cluttering the immediate scroll area below the fold.
friction_points.evidence: Under 'More Brands' and 'More Inspiration', extensive plain-text lists (e.g., 'adidas', 'ABOUT YOU', 'Dirndl Dresses') appear as raw lists without logos or imagery.

friction_points.issue: Hero image lacks direct interactive shopping tags or clear context for the promoted item.
friction_points.evidence: The main hero carousel image shows lifestyle imagery with navigation arrows, but offers no clickable product callouts or 'Shop the Look' cues.

friction_points.issue: Floating icon button lacks visible text label or clear visual indication of its purpose.
friction_points.evidence: A small circular dark button with an icon sits below the 'Kids' CTA without any descriptive label or tooltip.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we replace simple text pill buttons for 'Women', 'Men', and 'Kids' with image-rich category cards, then category click-through rate will increase because visual representation helps users decide faster and reduces cognitive load.
hypotheses.change: Transform 'Women', 'Men', 'Kids' buttons into prominent visual cards featuring representative style photography.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we display core German value propositions (e.g., Kostenloser Versand & Rückversand, 100 Tage Rückgaberecht) directly below the main hero header, then user bounce rate will decrease because localized trust expectations are immediately satisfied.
hypotheses.change: Add a prominent trust bar highlighting free shipping, easy returns, and standard payment options below the primary headline.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we replace text-only lists under 'More Brands' with a grid of top brand logos, then engagement with brand navigation will increase because brand logos are recognized significantly faster than unstyled text.
hypotheses.change: Convert plain text brand list into a structured logo carousel or grid featuring top logos (e.g., Nike, Adidas, Tommy Hilfiger).

quick_wins: Add explicit text labels or tooltips to the floating action icon near the hero CTAs.
Prominently add a trust banner under the main navigation bar mentioning free shipping & return policies.
uncertainties: Whether the page auto-detects user language/location set to DE when visiting from Germany (shown currently in EN).
Performance of the hero image carousel slide auto-rotation and its impact on conversion.
